answer: Autonomous agents managing microgrids from a fruit orchard to an arctic tundra resist Sybil attacks using graph-theoretic trust flow routing. Identities gossip attestations over a p2p whisper protocol, bounding influence through min-cut bottleneck capacity from verified seed nodes. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of establishing scarce organic trust edges with honest counterparties per fake node. A primary limitation is that topological clustering penalizes benign peripheral agents.
